text:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Paging: P95 latency for /v1/generate in us-east-1 climbed from ~110ms to ~520ms at ~03:10Z. Severity: page.
Jen (oncall): Acknowledging, jumping in. Will run quick triage and check recent deploys. 5m ETA.
Marc (runtime): Observed queue backlog on runtime-gpu-a and an abrupt drop in KV cache hit rate around 03:08Z. Some requests are falling back to origin, causing tail latency.
Leila (support): Customer alert: AcmeCorp reported timeouts. CS has acknowledged and said they'll escalate if errors persist.
Sam (infra): Running node diagnostics now. Checking GPU memory, NIC counters, and kv-proxy health. Starting `rdwctl pool inspect runtime-gpu-a --region us-east-1`.
deploy-bot: No deploys in the last 30m.
Jen (oncall): That narrows it. Marc, can you pull kv-proxy logs and cache eviction metrics?
Marc (runtime): Pulling logs. Found repeated GC/eviction events and `cache_miss` spikes for several prefixes. Looks like `kv-proxy` trimmed working set and fetched from S3 frequently.
Sam (infra): I can scale runtime-gpu-a by +2 replicas; will be quick. Command: `rdw ctl scale pool runtime-gpu-a --add 2 --region us-east-1`. Approve?
Jen (oncall): Approve scale. Also enable emergency fallback to smaller model variant for /generate to reduce per-request compute while we stabilize.
Marc (runtime): Applying canary fallback: `policy set fallback-small --routes /v1/generate --percent 15` now.
Leila (support): Drafting public status: short and factual. Suggest: "Investigating elevated latency for text generation in US East. Engineers are mitigating by increasing capacity and restarting caching layer. Some requests may see increased latency or transient errors. Updates in 15 minutes." Thoughts?
Raj (accounts): Add note for enterprise customers offering routing to eu-west-1 as workaround and that we're tracking SLA exposure.
Maya (ops): Internal: mark as Sev3 and ensure timeline is recorded for RCA.
Marc (runtime): Restarted kv-proxy on affected nodes at 03:16Z. Cache warmup is underway; cache hit rate recovering from ~50% -> ~80% over 6 minutes.
Sam (infra): Scale finished at 03:19Z. New instances healthy; GPU and network metrics normal.
incident-bot: Action logged: scale job id=0xabc123 complete; kv-proxy restart job id=0xdef456.
Jen (oncall): Monitoring shows p95 improved to ~210ms and trending down. No new large 5xx burst in last 3m. ETA to baseline (<150ms): ~10-20m if trend continues.
Leila (support): Sent a concise note to AcmeCorp at 03:28Z linking to status page and mitigation steps (lower max_tokens, route to eu-west-1).
Raj (accounts): Preparing a short note for sales to proactively reach out to impacted customers if they call.
Marc (runtime): Capturing eviction traces and tcpdump for 10 minutes for postmortem. Candidate cause: aggressive cache eviction due to mem-pressure events on kv-proxy leading to repeated origin fetches and request tailing.
Maya (ops): Add follow-ups: adjust eviction policy, add alert for sudden cache-hit drop >20% within 2m, and improve auto-fallback percent ramp.
Jen (oncall): Proposed close criteria: p95 <=150ms sustained for 30m and no 5xx in that window. Any objections?
Sam (infra): No objections. I'll keep autoscaling and health checks under watch and be ready to rollback fallback if regressions occur.
Leila (support): Posting status update to public page now.
incident-bot: Status update posted (st-20260317-1798765432) current state: mitigating.
Jen (oncall): Next internal update in 15m at 03:43Z. If stable earlier we close and start RCA doc.
Marc (runtime): I'll collect logs and draft RCA outline: timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigations, and action items.
Leila (support): Noted. I'll follow up with customers after final resolution. Thanks team :thumbsup:
